new_results.statement: For Q=2(X0+ell.X_L)(g.X_L)+d(beta.X_L)^2, literal source split L=J union K with g_K=0, rho=||beta_K||>0, ell_K=a beta_K+r, r perp beta_K, eta=||r||>0, and normalized private two-frame b=beta_K/rho, v=r/eta satisfying b_k^2+v_k^2<=1/2, one has ||p_Q||inf <=3*2^(4/3) M_G^(2/3)(rho^2 eta^2 |d|)^(-1/3), where M_G=||p_(g_J.X_J)||inf; hence <=3*2^(5/3)(|d| ||g||^2 rho^2 eta^2)^(-1/3) by LPP.

For m>=8, Q_(m,eta)=2(X0+eta v.X_K)G+(b.X_K)^2 with b_j=1/sqrt(m) and centered-linear unit v_j has exact nonzero spectrum {-sqrt(1+eta^2),1,+sqrt(1+eta^2)}. Distinct ratios v_j/b_j force every r34-aligned private subbank to be a singleton, giving r34 certificate 2^(13/4)sqrt(m), while the aggregate theorem gives 3*2^(4/3)eta^(-2/3) when G is an original coordinate; at eta=1 the whole-line bound is 7.559526299369239 uniformly in m.
